summary: Listed in the tnlandforms.us Georgia lookout index as a Screven County tower at 32.608734, -81.403529; no build, fate or site record found.

evidence.supports: index lists a stockton plantation tower in Screven County with its coordinates
the page is the Georgia lookout towers index

notes_for_editor: Story is about 35 words, far under the 120-word floor, because the only source is one index row (GA419). The index elevation column has no unit label, so no elevation is used. The row's notes column reads 'Ron restored'; the page credits 'Ron Stafford' with supplying tower locations, but the note is not explained, so it is left out of the story rather than read as a restoration claim. Two web searches found nothing about a tower at Stockton Plantation in Screven County. The Stockton in those results is in Lanier County, unrelated. Screven County's registered tower is the Sylvania Lookout Tower (NHLR US 957, GA 15, https://www.nhlr.org/lookouts/us/ga/sylvania-lookout-tower/), about 29 km away at its listed coordinates; do not merge the two. Recommend holding from publication until a second source turns up.
